text:
Sunita Rao: Quick noteI handed in my resignation today; last day will be Fri Dec 6. Need help coordinating final pay, whether Im eligible for the year-end bonus/merit cycle prorate, COBRA/benefits cutoff, returning laptop + security token, and an exit interview. Also I have a pending performance calibration meeting next week  does that affect anything?
People Ops: Thanks for the heads up, Sunita. We'll start the offboard checklist. Short answers: benefits typically run through month-end of termination (coverage through 2024-12-31 if last day Dec 6). COBRA packet (US) or local continuation info will be emailed within ~10 business days. Well schedule an exit interview. Please confirm shipping address for devices.
Sunita Rao: Confirming address: 88 Parker Ave, Apt 3, Boston MA 02118. Regarding bonus: my manager said comp/people would confirm prorated eligibility if my termination date is before payout.
Maya (Manager): Sunita  we'll keep you in the calibration conversation but final decisions come from Comp/People Ops. I'll flag your case in the calibration and ask comp to confirm whether you'll be included in the cycle prorate. Please leave final feedback notes for each direct report.
Payroll: Final paycheck note: final salary + accrued PTO payout will be processed on the next payroll run after termination (standard schedule). If bonus/merit is approved, payout timing varies. Submit any outstanding expenses by Nov 30 to be included. DM payroll for a quick calc.
Raj - IT: For device returns: we'll email a prepaid FedEx label. Please factory reset personal phone data and ship the YubiKey separately marked "security token". Deprovision schedule (tentative):
```
2024-12-06 10:00 ET - disable new device enrollments
2024-12-06 15:00 ET - revoke elevated roles
2024-12-06 23:59 ET - full account disable
```
People Ops: Action items: [Sunita] confirm address (done), add handoff notes + flag any open hires; [Maya] include Sunita in calibration + note to Comp; [Raj] send label + manage device wipe; [Payroll] confirm final pay/balance and bonus eligibility. We'll schedule a 30-min exit interview Tue Dec 10 or Wed Dec 11  which works?
Sunita Rao: Wed Dec 11 morning works. I'll post handoff notes and finalize PRs by Mon EOD. Thanks all. :pray:
